admin.title: AI providers
admin.description: Choose how new research runs use Qwen and Gemini.
admin.routingHelp: This policy applies to new research runs across all workspaces.
admin.primaryHelp: The selected provider handles analysis and native web retrieval.
admin.fallbackHelp: Try the other provider if the primary has a configuration, credit, availability, or retrieval failure.
admin.fallbackLimit: One-way fallback only. Validation, evidence, and budget failures never trigger another provider.
admin.saved: Provider settings saved. New research runs will use this policy.
admin.saveFailed: Settings could not be saved. Your changes are still here; please try again.
admin.notConfigured: A selected provider is missing its server credentials. Choose a configured provider and disable fallback, or ask the project owner to check the project variables.
admin.accessExpired: Your administrator session is no longer authorized. Sign in again before saving.
admin.loadFailed: Settings could not be refreshed. Reload them before making changes.
admin.credentialsHelp: Keys stay on the server. Configured means credentials are present, not that billing or provider access has been verified.
admin.accessHelp: Verified administrators and this verified email can change provider settings. Administrator roles must be assigned on the server; other workspace members cannot access this page.
admin.scope: Initialized research keeps its saved model choices. Evidence requirements, development access, and spending limits are unchanged.
admin.workspaceEndpoint: The server replaces {WorkspaceId} with the configured Beijing workspace ID. Keys never reach the browser.
admin.modelBudget: Max and Argon use more of the same research budget and may hit the existing limit sooner. Native search context and query costs are estimates, not provider-enforced caps. Google Search requires paid-tier access.
